checks: Three same-document views have distinct slots and existing editors survive third-pane creation.
Native three-view editing shares one autosave revision and journal;Undo/Redo broadcast across views.
Native first boundary resizes adjacent panes without remounting any editor.
Native Ctrl+Alt+PageDown/PageUp targets three distinct same-resource sessions;middle-pane link and Back leave sibling journeys unchanged.
Second native boundary responds to keyboard sizing.
Three assignments,active session and slot weights restore from the Rust-owned receipt after restart.
Narrow three-assignment workspace shows one active pane and no unreachable resize boundaries.
Native capacity3→2→1 retains active view and parks the other sessions in Open Notes.
Wide code and12-column table retain independent horizontal ranges while the main application remains horizontally contained. Programmatic native scroll-range check;not physical trackpad acceptance.

Seven native browser surfaces captured with body/main horizontal containment;four emulated viewport/DPR cases reject toolbar overlap;Settings Light/Dark/OLED,Help,palette and Activity captured. These do not certify physical keyboard,IME,touchpad or Windows scaling.
limitations: No OS cache flush; first-profile startup is not true cold boot.
Input-to-rAF is a responsiveness proxy, not physical input-to-presentation.
Process working sets sum shared pages; sampled peak can miss short spikes.
M6 uses an isolated WebView2 profile to coexist with a running personal app; first-profile webview caches differ from M1–M5 shared-profile runs.

Only the disposable application process tree is sampled; background apps, power and cache conditions are uncontrolled. The M8 reference had a coexisting personal process; inspect coexistingPersonalReference for this run.
